method: Ranked by arithmetic over the daily screen — momentum, return on capital, proximity to the 52-week high, breakout and liquidity — after four floors: ₹5 cr turnover, price above the 200-day with 50 above 200, RSI at or under 78, and ROCE 12%+ or Piotroski 6+. One name per sector. The sentences are model-written from those same numbers, after the ranking was fixed.
